about: The one playable floor shared by every Endless arena skin. Frozen: changing it means regenerating and re-validating every skin. Rifts keep their own art-derived floors (ADR-0011). Render the PNGs with tools/art/make_endless_floor_template.py.
space: Texture UV of the 941x1672 background: (0, 0) top-left, (1, 1) bottom-right.
source_rect_note: [u_min, v_min, u_max, v_max] = GameWorld.ARENA_FLOOR_UV, the formation distribution rect and design scale (ADR-0006).
